name: ShipStation Connector
description: Connect to ShipStation for shipments, carriers, and warehouses. New connections use API v2 (https://api.shipstation.com, API-Key header). V1 (ssapi.shipstation.com, HTTP Basic) stays available and has no published sunset.
use_cases: Carrier and warehouse inventory of ship-from locations

entity.name: ShipStation
entity.description: ShipStation fulfillment via CatalogRuntimeConnector. V2 (recommended) lists shipments, carriers, and warehouses. V1 still lists shipments, orders, carriers, and warehouses.

enum_labels.v1: V1 legacy — ssapi.shipstation.com, HTTP Basic (no published sunset)

api_generation.help: Records which ShipStation API generation this connection intends to use. It does not rewrite the request. The sync_entity action does. v2_shipments, v2_carriers, and v2_warehouses call https://api.shipstation.com/v2 with header API-Key set from connection.api_key. shipments, orders, carriers, and warehouses call https://ssapi.shipstation.com with HTTP Basic (username = V1 API key, api_key = V1 API secret). One api_key cannot hold both generations. A mismatch fails the call. There is no fallback. V1 has no published sunset. There is no V2 orders list under /v2 (sales orders are /v-beta and are not in this package).

sync_entity.description: ShipStation entity this connection syncs. v2_* entities are API v2 and are the default for new connections. Unprefixed names are V1 and stay valid (no published sunset).

order_status.description: Order status filter when sync_entity is orders (V1 orderStatus query param). V2 has no orders entity in this package.

filter.description: Optional free-form filter hint for polling (use 'all' for no extra filter).

placeholders.{{API_KEY}}: ShipStation V2 API key, sent as the API-Key header. For a V1 connection, store the V1 API Secret here, set username to the V1 API Key, set custom_settings.api_generation to v1, and set sync_entity to shipments, orders, carriers, or warehouses. One connection cannot hold both generations in api_key.
placeholders.{{API_SECRET}}: V1 API Secret name kept for existing setup notes. New connections put the V2 API key in {{API_KEY}}, which is stored as connection.api_key. V1 basic auth still reads the secret from connection.api_key and the key from connection.username.

connector_package.description: ShipStation via CatalogRuntimeConnector. New connections use API v2: host api.shipstation.com, header API-Key, connection.api_key. V1 stays: host ssapi.shipstation.com, HTTP Basic, connection.username = API Key, connection.api_key = API Secret. custom_settings.api_generation records intent and does not switch the request. The sync_entity action does. Connection test still calls V1 list warehouses (basic auth, warehouseId). A V2-only key fails that test. There is no second probe and no fallback.
follow_up_notes: V1 page/pageSize responses expose top-level page and pages. V1 carriers and warehouses return bare arrays (pagination none).
V2 list shipments and list carriers return shipments or carriers plus total, page, pages, and links, and take page and page_size. V2 list warehouses returns {warehouses} and is not paginated.
V1 orders stay on GET /orders. There is no GA GET /v2/orders. V2 purchase orders and /v-beta/sales_orders are not in this package.
V1 has no published sunset. Docs recommend V2 for new integrations (https://docs.shipstation.com/apis/openapi). V1 reference: https://www.shipstation.com/docs/api/requirements/.
Optional: add stores/customers/products list actions if product scope expands beyond fulfillment entities.

warehouses.name: Warehouses
warehouses.description: V1 Ship From Locations (warehouses). Bare array. Identity field warehouseId.

v2_shipments.name: Shipments (V2)
v2_shipments.description: API v2 shipments (GET /v2/shipments). Identity field shipment_id.

v2_carriers.name: Carriers (V2)
v2_carriers.description: API v2 carriers (GET /v2/carriers). Identity field carrier_id.

v2_warehouses.name: Warehouses (V2)
v2_warehouses.description: API v2 warehouses (GET /v2/warehouses). Identity field warehouse_id. Response is an object, not a bare array.
